hooks.command: jq -c 'if (.tool_input.file_path // "") | test("\\.sql$|\\.prisma$|/migrations/|schema\\.ts$") then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", additionalContext: "Schema design context: this file is a database schema or migration. Consult Data Engineering/playbooks/02-schema-design.md and use Data Engineering/databases/database-designer for implementation. Pair with Data Engineering/governance-and-quality/data-quality-auditor for a post-build profile. Bypass: say just write the migration or name a specific skill to skip the playbook."}} else empty end' 2>/dev/null || true

jq -c 'if (.prompt // "") | test("\\b(audit\\s+(my\\s+|the\\s+)?data|data\\s+quality|anomalies\\s+in|profile\\s+(this\\s+|the\\s+)?dataset)\\b"; "i") then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "UserPromptSubmit", additionalContext: "Data quality audit context: consult Data Engineering/playbooks/04-quality-audit.md. Start with governance-and-quality/data-quality-auditor (profile + DQS + remediation plan), then branch by root cause: schema -> databases/database-designer; policy -> governance-and-quality/mdm-and-federated-governance; forward prevention -> pipelines/analytics-pipeline-orchestration/skills/quality-gates. Bypass: just profile the data or skip the playbook."}} else empty end' 2>/dev/null || true

jq -c 'if (.prompt // "") | test("\\b(build|design|set\\s+up|architect)\\s+.{0,30}\\b(RAG|knowledge\\s+graph|semantic\\s+search|vector\\s+search)\\b"; "i") then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "UserPromptSubmit", additionalContext: "Retrieval architecture context: ALWAYS read Data Engineering/references/structured-vs-unstructured-retrieval.md FIRST to choose between knowledge graph, RAG, and text-to-SQL - most production systems use a hybrid. Then proceed via Data Engineering/playbooks/06-retrieval-architecture.md. Bypass: already chose [KG/RAG/text-to-SQL] or just need [specific skill]."}} else empty end' 2>/dev/null || true
